articles.title: At least 30 people reported dead in high-speed Spain train crash
articles.description: It is the second deadly high-speed train collision in Spain this year.

articles.title: A Democratic win in midterms could put prediction markets and the CFTC in the hot seat
articles.description: A Democratic House could increase scrutiny of prediction markets, the CFTC and the industry’s ties to the Trump family after the midterms.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs above $81,000 as majors rally ahead of Fed decision
articles.description: HYPE and ZEC led a broad bounce, with every top token in the green hours before the Federal Reserve’s rate call.

articles.title: Mirae Asset Securities issues tokenized notes on Solana
articles.description: The company’s Hong Kong unit issued six-month notes under its $3 billion program, extending blockchain-based distribution to institutional investors.

articles.title: Google alters its cloud playbook, enlisting partners to sell more AI chips
articles.description: Google is opening its TPU business beyond its own cloud as custom chips become a bigger engine for growth.

articles.title: Mortgage rates fell for the second straight week, but more borrowers still sought savings in riskier loans
articles.description: Mortgage rates have fallen over the past two weeks, but demand is only slightly higher, and more borrowers are looking for savings in riskier loans.

articles.title: Google to preview crypto custody security system as AI threats grow
articles.description: Google Multi-Party Compute is in private preview, with several major financial institutions testing the technology and parent company Alphabet using it to secure its own digital assets on Ethereum and Solana.

articles.title: Bithumb Says Hackers Accessed Internal System, Leaking Personal Data
articles.description: South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange is checking whether customer data was exposed, as two other financial firms report breaches.

articles.title: Nearly 90% of large businesses are embracing tokenized cash to speed up payments: DBS
articles.description: Stablecoins lead instruments in use or planned at 63%, ahead of tokenized deposits at 53% and tokenized money market funds at 52%.

articles.title: Stellantis reports $4.5 billion cash drain as massive turnaround plan continues
articles.description: European car giant Stellantis said Wednesday that it recorded a 4 billion euro ($4.5 billion) cash shortfall in the third quarter.

articles.title: Coinbase Customer Data Hit in Analytics Vendor Breach, Funds ‘Not Impacted’
articles.description: The incident at analytics firm Amplitude hit a "small subset" of Coinbase customers, the exchange said, without saying how many.

articles.title: Brazil’s largest lender becomes first bank to formalize crypto brokerage under new rules
articles.description: Itaú Unibanco notified Brazil’s central bank of its crypto trading and custody operations on Tuesday, ahead of an Oct. 30 deadline.

articles.title: Musk's PAC lawyer runs in Texas House district that is home to billionaire's business interests
articles.description: A chip factory being built by Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX is in Texas's 10th District, where his PAC's former lawyer Chris Gober is the GOP U.S. House nominee.

articles.title: Kospi surges 7% as SK Hynix earnings fuel AI stock rebound
articles.description: South Korean chipmakers led a broader AI recovery after SK Hynix reported a sevenfold profit surge and announced another $45 billion in shareholder returns.

articles.title: Bitcoin price eyes $82K as Morgan Stanley strategist says most of correction is over
articles.description: Bitcoin sought to rebuild support at $80,000 while Asian and US tech stocks extended a rebound into key corporate earnings releases.

articles.title: UBS pretax profits jump 27% in third quarter to $3.59 billion as wealth inflows surge
articles.description: UBS reported a third quarter pretax profit of almost $3.6 billion.

articles.title: Robinhood shares fall as crypto slump weighs on profits, offsetting gains in new businesses
articles.description: Robinhood's third-quarter revenue met expectations, fueled by the company's expansion into options, predictions markets and other financial services.

articles.title: Treasury yields tick higher ahead of Federal Reserve interest rate decision
articles.description: Treasury yields edged higher as traders await the Federal Reserve's latest monetary policy decision.

articles.title: Here's how much bitcoin and the S&P 500 could rally after midterms
articles.description: Both bitcoin and the S&P 500 have historically produced positive returns in a year after midterms. BTC's pattern, however, could also be explained by the four-year halving cycles.

articles.title: Israeli bonds, shekel fall as election leaves Netanyahu and others far short of majorities
articles.description: Exit polls show Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's alliance and Gadi Eisenkot's opposition bloc both well off the numbers needed to form a governing majority.
